errors.error_description: Introduced an escaped identifier using a reserved keyword as a signal name: logic \always_comb ; to misuse a language keyword as an identifier.
Created a combinational always block sensitive to (opcode or enable) but reading cond_match inside, omitting it from the sensitivity list.
Drove an input port from within the module using a continuous assignment: assign enable = internal_enable;.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same sequential block by using a blocking assignment to valid_r alongside non-blocking assignments.
